question: **Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure**: The candidates were found to have been submitting forged documents during verification.

options.text: The verification process found the candidates had submitted forged documents.
It was found that forged documents had been submitted by candidates.
The candidates were found submitting forgeries, as verified.
Officials found that the candidates had been submitting forged documents.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The candidates were found to have been submitting forged documents during verification."
 
• To convert to active voice: The subject "Officials" is introduced as the doer of the action.
